text:
olivia_csm: Quick Q2 check-in for AcmeCorp onboarding — seeing a small but persistent uptick in 5xxs and client timeouts this week. attaching a short breakdown. :clipboard:

maria_cs: thanks - is this correlated with increased token spend or new usage patterns?

olivia_csm: usage is actually steady. core spikes line up with onboarding test traffic (their integration harness) hitting specific routes. latency steady for most calls but a few routes show higher tail latency.

aj_engineer: can you paste the top failing URIs? i'll triage with infra.

olivia_csm: top failing endpoints (past 48h, aggregated):
- POST /api/v1/generate  -> 5xx spike (502/503 mix), error-rate 2.7% vs baseline 0.3%
- POST /api/v1/chat/stream -> client timeouts (upstream read timeout) 1.9%
- POST /api/v1/embeddings -> 429 rate-limited bursts, 3.6% during onboarding test windows
- PUT /api/v1/session/kv -> high p99 latency/timeouts on large payloads

leo_sre: sharing a short log snippet from our edge (redacted):
```
2026-03-17T14:12:08Z INF request POST /api/v1/generate id=abc123 duration=0.31s status=502 upstream=grpc://inference-01 err="connection reset by peer"
2026-03-17T14:12:08Z INF request POST /api/v1/generate id=abc124 duration=0.28s status=503 upstream=grpc://inference-02 err="server unavailable"
```

leo_sre: looks like backend inference nodes occasionally OOM/worker crash -> 502/503. i'll check pod restarts and memory churn.

aj_engineer: for the chat.stream timeouts - are we seeing long-lived streams hitting our proxy idle timeouts? can we check keepalive/stream window logs?

olivia_csm: yes, their integration opens persistent streams during onboarding tests. they also send larger-than-normal initial system prompts.

maria_cs: renewal risk? Acme is in trial but heavy on timelines. if onboarding stalls, risk to conversion. i flagged for enablement to help them reduce burstiness.

deploy-bot: deploy rtx-2026.03.17-heap-fix -> success (inference-02) 2026-03-17T15:04:02Z :rocket:

leo_sre: deployed a memory-pinning fix to inference-02; node stabilized, pod restart count dropped to 0 in the last hour. 5xxs for /generate dropped ~70% post-deploy.

aj_engineer: pushed a short-term proxy config change to increase stream idle timeout to 120s and raise concurrent stream limit for that account test token.

olivia_csm: great. embeddings 429s — is this due to bursty parallel calls from the harness? any quick throttle policy we can suggest?

aj_engineer: yes. recommend: backoff/client-side concurrency cap (4), and introduce jittered retry; we can add an enforcement rule that maps their API key to a soft rate limit for the trial window to prevent noisy neighbors. i can draft the enforcement rule.

maria_cs: i will coordinate enablement to ask Acme to reduce parallelism during the next test run and provide a short how-to. i'll also surface the timeline: fix deployed + proxy change now; ask them to rerun onboarding tests tomorrow morning.

olivia_csm: action items:
- leo_sre: confirm no further OOMs and monitor 5xx at 1h cadence until EOD (owner)
- aj_engineer: draft soft rate-limit rule + client guidance (owner)
- maria_cs: send enablement note and schedule rerun with Acme (owner)

maria_cs: sending note now. tagging @aj_engineer for the guidance doc. :email:

aj_engineer: starting draft, will drop link in channel when ready.

olivia_csm: thanks team. i'll check back with a short status update after their rerun (CC: renewals). :eyes:
